self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Echo: Normal/Charged Attack hits have a 50% chance (CD 8s) to fire a Bolt of Perception dealing 360% ATK DMG, which can bounce to up to 4 additional opponents; modeled as a supplementary hit on the primary target — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses (bounce DMG to other targets not modeled).
